elements.requirement: Nothing in the Landlord and Tenant (Covenants) Act 1995, including section 25, prevents a tenant who is released to any extent from a tenant covenant on an assignment from entering into an authorised guarantee agreement regarding the assignee's performance of that covenant.
elements.quote: nothing in this Act (and in particular section 25) shall preclude him from entering into an authorised guarantee agreement with respect to the performance of that covenant by the assignee

elements.requirement: A relevant covenant is defined as a tenant covenant of a tenancy from which a tenant is to any extent released on an assignment by virtue of the Landlord and Tenant (Covenants) Act 1995.
elements.quote: Where on an assignment a tenant is to any extent released from a tenant covenant of a tenancy by virtue of this Act (“the relevant covenant”)

elements.requirement: An agreement constitutes an authorised guarantee agreement if the tenant guarantees to any extent the assignee's performance of the relevant covenant, the agreement is entered into in the circumstances set out in subsection (3), and its provisions conform with subsections (4) and (5).
elements.quote: an agreement is an authorised guarantee agreement if— (a) under it the tenant guarantees the performance of the relevant covenant to any extent by the assignee; and (b) it is entered into in the circumstances set out in subsection (3); and (c) its provisions conform with subsections (4) and (5)

elements.requirement: The circumstances required for an authorised guarantee agreement include that the assignment cannot be effected without the consent of the landlord or another person due to an absolute or qualified covenant against assignment.
elements.quote: by virtue of a covenant against assignment (whether absolute or qualified) the assignment cannot be effected without the consent of the landlord under the tenancy or some other person

elements.requirement: The circumstances required for an authorised guarantee agreement include that the required consent to assign is given subject to a lawfully imposed condition requiring the tenant to enter into an agreement guaranteeing the assignee's performance of the covenant.
elements.quote: any such consent is given subject to a condition (lawfully imposed) that the tenant is to enter into an agreement guaranteeing the performance of the covenant by the assignee

elements.requirement: The circumstances required for an authorised guarantee agreement include that the guarantee agreement is entered into by the tenant in pursuance of the condition attached to the consent.
elements.quote: the agreement is entered into by the tenant in pursuance of that condition

elements.requirement: An agreement is not an authorised guarantee agreement to the extent that it purports to require the tenant to guarantee the performance of the relevant covenant by any person other than the assignee.
elements.quote: An agreement is not an authorised guarantee agreement to the extent that it purports— (a) to impose on the tenant any requirement to guarantee in any way the performance of the relevant covenant by any person other than the assignee

elements.requirement: An agreement is not an authorised guarantee agreement to the extent that it purports to impose on the tenant any liability, restriction, or requirement of any nature relating to any time after the assignee is released from the relevant covenant under the Landlord and Tenant (Covenants) Act 1995.
elements.quote: to impose on the tenant any liability, restriction or other requirement (of whatever nature) in relation to any time after the assignee is released from that covenant by virtue of this Act

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (4), an authorised guarantee agreement may impose liability on the tenant as sole or principal debtor in respect of any obligation owed by the assignee under the relevant covenant.
elements.quote: impose on the tenant any liability as sole or principal debtor in respect of any obligation owed by the assignee under the relevant covenant

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (4), an authorised guarantee agreement may impose guarantor liabilities on the tenant regarding the assignee’s performance of the covenant, provided they are no more onerous than the liabilities the tenant would bear as sole or principal debtor for the assignee's obligations under that covenant.
elements.quote: impose on the tenant liabilities as guarantor in respect of the assignee’s performance of that covenant which are no more onerous than those to which he would be subject in the event of his being liable as sole or principal debtor in respect of any obligation owed by the assignee under that covenant

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (4), an authorised guarantee agreement may require the tenant, if the assigned tenancy is disclaimed, to enter into a new tenancy of the assigned premises whose term expires not later than the assigned tenancy's term and whose tenant covenants are no more onerous than those of that assigned tenancy.
elements.quote: require the tenant, in the event of the tenancy assigned by him being disclaimed, to enter into a new tenancy of the premises comprised in the assignment— (i) whose term expires not later than the term of the tenancy assigned by the tenant, and (ii) whose tenant covenants are no more onerous than those of that tenancy

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (4), an authorised guarantee agreement may make incidental or supplementary provision to the terms permitted under paragraphs (a) to (c) of subsection (5).
elements.quote: make provision incidental or supplementary to any provision made by virtue of any of paragraphs (a) to (c)

elements.requirement: Where a former tenant is released to any extent from a tenancy covenant under section 11(2) upon an assignment and the assignor enters into an authorised guarantee agreement with the landlord concerning the assignee's performance of that covenant, the landlord may require the former tenant to enter into an agreement guaranteeing the assignee's performance on corresponding terms.
elements.quote: the landlord may require the former tenant to enter into an agreement under which he guarantees, on terms corresponding to those of that authorised guarantee agreement, the performance of that covenant by the assignee under the assignment

elements.requirement: An agreement entered into by a former tenant under subsection (6)(a) constitutes an authorised guarantee agreement if its provisions conform with subsections (4) and (5).
elements.quote: if its provisions conform with subsections (4) and (5), any such agreement shall be an authorised guarantee agreement for the purposes of this section

elements.requirement: In applying section 16 to an agreement entered into by a former tenant under subsection (6), subsections (2)(b), (2)(c), and (3) are omitted, and references to the tenant or assignee must be read as references to the former tenant or the assignee under the assignment.
elements.quote: in the application of this section in relation to any such agreement— (i) subsections (2)(b) and (c) and (3) shall be omitted, and (ii) any reference to the tenant or to the assignee shall be read as a reference to the former tenant or to the assignee under the assignment

elements.requirement: For the purposes of entering into an authorised guarantee agreement under subsection (1), it is immaterial that the tenant previously entered into an authorised guarantee agreement for an earlier assignment of the tenancy that subsequently revested in the tenant following a disclaimer on behalf of the previous assignee.
elements.quote: the tenant has already made an authorised guarantee agreement in respect of a previous assignment by him of the tenancy referred to in that subsection, it having been subsequently revested in him following a disclaimer on behalf of the previous assignee

elements.requirement: For the purposes of entering into an authorised guarantee agreement under subsection (1), it is immaterial that the assigned tenancy is a new tenancy entered into by the tenant pursuant to an authorised guarantee agreement.
elements.quote: the tenancy referred to in that subsection is a new tenancy entered into by the tenant in pursuance of an authorised guarantee agreement

elements.requirement: Where a tenancy was revested following disclaimer or is a new tenancy entered into pursuant to an authorised guarantee agreement, subsections (2) to (5) apply accordingly.
elements.quote: and in any such case subsections (2) to (5) shall apply accordingly

elements.requirement: Subject to its terms, the general rules of law relating to guarantees, particularly those concerning the release of sureties, apply to any authorised guarantee agreement in the same way as they apply to any other guarantee agreement.
elements.quote: the rules of law relating to guarantees (and in particular those relating to the release of sureties) are, subject to its terms, applicable in relation to any authorised guarantee agreement as in relation to any other guarantee agreement
